fig 1C
```{r}
# Read in the data
data <- read_excel(
  here("data", "validation.xlsx"),
  sheet = "mafb tdtomato rbpms fig1C")

# Calculate percent colocalization
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Animal = str_extract(ID, "id\\d+"),  # Extract Animal ID
    percent_mafb = (mafb / tdtomato) * 100,
    percent_rbpms = (rbpms / tdtomato) * 100
  )

# Average across images per animal
animal_avg <- data %>%
  group_by(Animal) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_mafb = mean(percent_mafb, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rbpms = mean(percent_rbpms, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Now average across animals and calculate SEM
summary_data <- tibble(
  mean_mafb = mean(animal_avg$mean_mafb, na.rm = TRUE),
  sem_mafb = sd(animal_avg$mean_mafb, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(nrow(animal_avg)),
  mean_rbpms = mean(animal_avg$mean_rbpms, na.rm = TRUE),
  sem_rbpms = sd(animal_avg$mean_rbpms, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(nrow(animal_avg))
)

# Convert to long format for ggplot2
summary_long <- summary_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("mean"),
    names_to = "Marker",
    values_to = "Mean"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SEM = c(summary_data$sem_mafb, summary_data$sem_rbpms),
    Marker = recode(Marker, "mean_mafb" = "MAFB", "mean_rbpms" = "RBPMS")
  )

# Define your custom marker colors
marker_colors <- c("MAFB" = "#808080", "RBPMS" = "#555555")

# Plot
mafb <- ggplot(summary_long, aes(x = Marker, y = Mean)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           width = 0.8,
           aes(color = Marker),
           fill = marker_colors,
           size = 3) +
 geom_errorbar(
  aes(ymin = Mean - SEM, ymax = Mean + SEM),
  width = 0.5,
  linewidth = 1.5,     # line thickness
  color = "black",     # force black color
  position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)
)+
  geom_jitter(
    data = animal_avg %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c(mean_mafb, mean_rbpms),
        names_to = "Marker",
        values_to = "Value"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Marker = recode(
          Marker,
          "mean_mafb" = "MAFB",
          "mean_rbpms" = "RBPMS"
        )
      ),
    aes(x = Marker, y = Value, fill = Marker),
    shape = 21,
    size = 8,
    stroke = 2,
    color = "black",
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = marker_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = marker_colors) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = NULL,
    y = "% colocalization with mCherry cells"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
   theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 30, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1.5),             # Tick thickness
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )+
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 110),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  )

mafb

ggsave("mafb_colocalization.pdf", plot = mafb, path = save, device = pdf, width = 4, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
fig 1I
```{r}
# Read in the data
data <- read_excel(
  here("data", "validation.xlsx"),
  sheet = "tdtomato gfp fig1I")

# Calculate percent colocalization
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Animal = str_extract(ID, "id\\d+"),  # Extract Animal ID
    percent_e = (`GFPTdt` / `Tdtomato`) * 100,
    percent_s = (`GFPTdt` / `GFP`) * 100
  )

# Average across images per animal
animal_avg <- data %>%
  group_by(Animal) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_e = mean(percent_e, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_s = mean(percent_s, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


# Now average across animals and calculate SEM
summary_data <- tibble(
  mean_e = mean(animal_avg$mean_e, na.rm = TRUE),
  sem_e = sd(animal_avg$mean_e, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(nrow(animal_avg)),
  mean_s = mean(animal_avg$mean_s, na.rm = TRUE),
  sem_s = sd(animal_avg$mean_s, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(nrow(animal_avg))
)

# Convert to long format for ggplot2
summary_long <- summary_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("mean"),
    names_to = "Marker",
    values_to = "Mean"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SEM = c(summary_data$sem_e, summary_data$sem_s),
    Marker = recode(Marker, "mean_e" = "Efficiency", "mean_s" = "Specificity")
  )

# Define your custom marker colors
marker_colors <- c("Efficiency" = "#808080", "Specificity" = "#555555")

# Plot
colocalization <- ggplot(summary_long, aes(x = Marker, y = Mean)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           width = 0.8,
           aes(color = Marker),
           fill = marker_colors,
           size = 3) +
   geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean - SEM, ymax = Mean + SEM),
    width = 0.5,
    linewidth = 1.5,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = animal_avg %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c(mean_e, mean_s),
        names_to = "Marker",
        values_to = "Value"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Marker = recode(
          Marker,
          "mean_e" = "Efficiency",
          "mean_s" = "Specificity"
        )
      ),
    aes(x = Marker, y = Value, fill = Marker),
    shape = 21,
    size = 8,
    stroke = 2,
    color = "black",
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = marker_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = marker_colors) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = NULL,
    y = "%"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
   theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 30, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1.5),             # Tick thickness
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.4, "cm"))+
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 110),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  )
```

predicted frequency fig 1e
```{r}
# Define data in top-to-bottom order
predicted_frequencies <- tibble(
  Cluster = c("c45", "c43", "c39", "c34", "c30", "c23"),  # TOP → BOTTOM
  Frequency = c(0.5, 0.5, 1, 1.75, 2, 2)
)

# Factor levels (important for color mapping)
predicted_frequencies <- predicted_frequencies %>%
  mutate(Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = c("c23", "c30", "c34", "c39", "c43", "c45")))

# Custom colors
custom_colors <- c(
  "c23" = "#B0B0B0",
  "c30" = "#999999",
  "c34" = "#808080",
  "c39" = "#666666",
  "c43" = "#006B99",
  "c45" = "#009967"
)

# Plot with reverse stacking!
predicted <- ggplot(predicted_frequencies, aes(x = "Mafb+ RGCs", y = Frequency, fill = Cluster)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "black", size = 1, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Cluster),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5, reverse = TRUE),  # also reverse for text
    color = "black",
    size = 8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 10),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% predicted frequency") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 30, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1.5),             # Tick thickness
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )


# Show plot
predicted

ggsave("predicted_mafb.pdf", plot = predicted, path = save, device = pdf, width = 3, height = 6, dpi = 300)


```
